Author: Johnneylee Jack Rollins
Name: XivDesktop
Punchline: Launch Linux desktop apps into the game world (needs ghostty-dalamud).
Description: An app launcher for FINAL FANTASY XIV running under Wine on Linux. Lists the host's freedesktop applications and opens them as world panels through ghostty-dalamud's remote windows. Optional Umbra toolbar widget. In progress: /npc, a speaker you can ask questions in game (the dialogue works; the speaker does not appear in the world yet).
